metricsDefinitions.wasm: Exact non-shrinking linear-memory capacity high-water in actual workerd; not live allocator bytes.
metricsDefinitions.stagedFields: Maxima of individual raw CDP fields at synchronous boundary pauses; maxima need not occur at same stage. No continuous total-isolate peak claimed.
metricsDefinitions.processPeakWorkingSetBytes: OS-maintained physical process high-water, including all workerd isolates/code/bridge; not Cloudflare isolate accounting.

limitations: Fresh runtime per fixture; does not settle warm-isolate retention, concurrency or fragmentation across requests.
Standalone workerd does not reproduce Cloudflare production 128MiB enforcement.
No exact continuous JS+WASM+embedder maximum; use separate WASM high-water, raw staged counters, and OS process high-water.
